q2_fdsan.message: MUSL-FDSAN: attempted to close file descriptor 61, expected to be unowned, actually owned by FILE* 0x0000007f9bc1e6e8
q2_fdsan.closer: musl ld-so load_library_header -> close(fd 61) during a failed dlopen
q2_fdsan.trigger: Aves bundles Flutter plugin media_kit (media_kit_libs_android_video, libmpv family); it dlopens libmediandk.so -> OH XPM rejects the header mmap: 'Xpm check failed for libmediandk.so, errno for mmap is: 22' (EINVAL) -> 'failed to map header'. The loader opens the .so (fd 61), mmap fails, close(61) hits an fd a FILE* still owns.
q2_fdsan.is_blocker: NO — non-fatal; same lazy libmediandk dlopen the already-lit fd-mpv tolerates (DIGEST L459); only disables video, not the gallery grid; the clusters.csv A libre clue = exactly this

this_rounds_rule: A PLT symbol interposer in libandroid only overrides the PLT call site; Flutter's raster/GPU backend resolves EGL entries via eglGetProcAddress and calls through a cached pointer, bypassing the PLT override. To cover every path, the eglGetProcAddress interposer must also return the local hooks by name. 'unchanged' in the readout can mean 'the fix fired on one thread but the fatal call is on another path' — read the fault thread name (1.raster) and whether the crash stack contains the interposing library's frame, not just the wall symbol.
